name: Edith
tagline: A smart-glasses assistant that sees what you see and routes requests to agent skills that act, with a spoken confirmation first.

awards: Fetch.ai: OmegaClaw Skill Forge powered by Agentverse

problem: At conferences, pulling out a phone breaks the conversation and opportunities pass.
solution: An iOS app streams glasses audio and frames to Gemini Live; requests route through OmegaClaw to Agentverse skills that identify a badge, send a follow-up email or book a table through browser automation.
demo_moment: Team-described: look at a name badge, ask who it is, then ask to send a follow-up.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Fetch.ai: OmegaClaw Skill Forge powered by Agentverse” among 307 submissions.
Previews actions aloud before executing them.
Named after a film assistant judges recognise.

lessons: Wearables demo well when the action completes without the user looking down.
